instruction: Help me fix the 'docker: command not found' error when running 'docker ps'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to fix docker command not found error. This typically involves installing docker or docker.io package and potentially adding user to docker group. Evaluator runs 'docker --version' and checks if it succeeds (returns 1) or fails (returns 0). Expected output is '1\n' indicating docker is now accessible.
metadata.verification: Evaluator uses existing get_vm_command_line getter to execute 'docker --version >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 1 || echo 0'. If docker is installed and working, command exits with 0 and echo 1 is executed. Otherwise echo 0 is executed. Uses existing exact_match metric to compare against expected '1\n'.
